messages.subject: Computing model-implied mean vector
parts:
The model-implied covariance matrix and mean vector can be obtained in lavaan by using fitted(fit). However, I'm interested in the computations. I found how Sigma.hat can be computed in Yves' "SEM with lavaan" sheets:

attach(inspect(fit, "est"))
IB <- diag(nrow(beta)) - beta
IB.inv <- solve(IB)
Sigma.hat <- lambda %*% IB.inv %*% psi %*% t(IB.inv) %*% t(lambda) + theta

Is the model-implied mean vector computed as follows?:

Mu.hat <- lambda %*% IB.inv %*% alpha + nu

Thank you! Best, Marjolein

messages.subject: Re: Computing model-implied mean vector
parts:
Is the model-implied mean vector computed as follows?:

Mu.hat <- lambda %*% IB.inv %*% alpha + nu

Yes.  There is a function called computeMuHat.LISREL in the source code (line 761-783 in the file "lav_representation_lisrel.R") if you want to check out how this and other matrices are computed in lavaan.

Terry
